reason: Adds a sidebar QR-code interface for connecting phones or other devices to the DSH web UI through an auth-gated reverse proxy; human review is warranted because the proxy can expose the full agent shell over a reachable network port.

summaries.zh: 通过侧边栏二维码和带认证的反向代理，将手机等设备连接到 DeepSeek Harness Web UI。
summaries.en: Adds a sidebar QR-code interface and authenticated reverse proxy for connecting phones and other devices to the DeepSeek Harness web UI.

capabilities: Adds a QR-code connection button and settings card to the web UI
Runs a child Node.js reverse proxy bound to a network-accessible address
Exposes the web UI and WebSocket traffic to connected devices
Uses rotating secrets and session cookies for access control
